title: Design system and prototype visual fidelity for built screens
objective: Close the visual gap between the running app and docs/prototype/screenshots for every already-built screen: introduce the missing component CSS layer (classes consuming the existing --qiq-* tokens), an in-repo SVG icon set, and restyle the shell and all shipped screens to QuoteIQ_UI_Standards.md / prototype quality. Approved remediation plan: docs/ui-remediation/plan.md.
scope: Phase 1 - src/ui/src/theme/components.css: base element layer (links, focus-visible, tabular numerics), .qiq-btn variants (primary/secondary/danger/ghost, busy/disabled), .qiq-icon-btn with badge, form controls (input/textarea/select/date/toggle/radio, labels, required marker, inline error), .qiq-card, .qiq-chip reporting-category variants (incl. outlined Withdrawn), .qiq-table (right-aligned numerics, hover, pagination), dialog/scrim, toast stack, semantic banners, skeleton, empty state - all values from --qiq-* tokens only
Phase 1 - components/common/Icon.tsx: single-stroke-weight inline SVG icon set (nav, bell, help, search, export, calendar, arrows, refresh, menu-dots) derived from docs/prototype/app markup

Phase 2 - shell restyle: Sidebar (brand block, icons, accent active pill defining the previously-undefined .qiq-nav-item classes, badge chip, separator), UserCard (avatar disc, menu), TopBar (64px, search with icon, icon-buttons with count badge, Export secondary, + New Lead primary), Footer, dashboards/FilterBar

Phase 3 - restyle sweep across built screens: Leads list/detail/dialogs, Lead & Party forms (two-column grid, sticky footer), Parties, Settings tabs, User Manager, Tenant Manager, DrillListPage, 403/404, StatusChip, KpiCard/ChartCard polish (icon halo, 28-32px/700 value, card-link, menu)
Phase 4 - amend .claude/tasks/T-032..T-037 and T-040 to require the component library and per-screen side-by-side fidelity checks against docs/prototype/screenshots
Phase 5 - e2e_tests/tests/visual-shell.spec.ts computed-style smoke spec; regenerate docs/ui-remediation/current-state captures for human sign-off
out_of_scope: Building the dashboards/Alerts/Reports screens themselves (T-032..T-037, T-040)
Changing --qiq-* token values, themes, routing, Redux state, or backend code
Self-hosting the Inter font (optional follow-up; Segoe UI fallback accepted)
implementation_details: Port component patterns (nav pill, icon-btn, kpi halo, chips, shadows, select chevron data-URI) from docs/prototype/app/assets/css/styles.css but express every color/spacing via existing --qiq-* tokens (V-070 no-raw-hex grep must stay green); shadows/scrim may add new tokens in tokens.css if needed
Keep UI Standards token values (not prototype hexes) per approved plan decision 3; adjust only on visible mismatch at review
Existing structural inline styles may remain; decorative inline styling migrates to classes as each component is touched
Unit tests keying on data-testid/roles stay green; any test asserting inline-style substrings is updated to assert classes instead

unit: Existing UI unit suite stays green (tests key on data-testid/roles); tests asserting decorative inline-style substrings are updated to assert the new .qiq-* classes instead
Icon.tsx renders the requested glyph with role/aria-hidden semantics (new test)
Sidebar/TopBar tests extended: bell and help render accessible icon buttons (svg + aria-label), not literal Bell/Help text; active NavLink carries qiq-nav-item--active
integration: npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run build all clean
dotnet test QuoteIQ.slnx as a no-backend-change regression gate
V-070 no-raw-hex grep over src/ui/src stays green (components.css consumes tokens only)
e2e: visual-shell.spec.ts (V-082): real Keycloak login, then computed-style assertions - active nav item has accent pill background and no underline; + New Lead uses accent fill with accent-contrast text; a .qiq-card computes card surface, 1px subtle border, 10px radius; body font-family equals the token stack
Regenerate docs/ui-remediation/current-state/*.png for manual side-by-side sign-off vs docs/prototype/screenshots

findings.description: V-082 e2e (visual-shell.spec.ts) and the human side-by-side sign-off of the regenerated docs/ui-remediation/current-state captures were not executed by the evaluator because they require the full running stack (Keycloak + API + SPA + seed-shell-e2e.sh). The spec was reviewed statically instead: it is coherent, its assertions map exactly to the tokens.css light-theme values (accent #159aa6 = rgb(21,154,166), accent-contrast/surface-card #ffffff, radius-card 10px, font-sans begins Inter, 'Segoe UI'), and every selector/testid/class it references (sidebar-nav, new-lead-button, notification-bell, help-button, .qiq-card, .qiq-nav-item--active) exists in the shell components and components.css.
findings.evidence: e2e_tests/tests/visual-shell.spec.ts; src/ui/src/theme/tokens.css lines 18-150; src/ui/src/theme/components.css .qiq-nav-item/.qiq-card; src/ui/src/components/shell/TopBar.tsx testids.
findings.suggested_fix: Run visual-shell.spec.ts against the local docker stack and obtain human visual sign-off before final closure; no code change required.
findings.resolution: Human confirmed on 2026-07-14 that the ui-remediation (docs/ui-remediation) was already reviewed and approved, closing the visual side-by-side sign-off. visual-shell.spec.ts is committed and runs in CI against the stack. No code change required.

history.message: Created from human-approved remediation plan docs/ui-remediation/plan.md (visual fidelity gap found on 2026-07-13 review).
